name: Create a document from a template

elements.name: Navigate home from a template folder

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the standard metric assembly template details are displayed
the template root has no templates directly in it
the user selects Home in the chooser navigation bar
the template root is selected in the folder tree
the gallery type sections contain no template entries
the metric assembly template details remain displayed
the user chooses Back in the chooser navigation bar
the metric template folder and its gallery are displayed again
